digest.component_or_area: operation snapshot binding and config composition
propositions: CLI, MCP, and Python command-write operations must each compose exactly one immutable OperationSnapshot once after input parsing and before lock/network/write, reusing it through nested seams via contextvar binding

OperationSnapshot must be authoritative for tracker directory, branch, and remote resolution; these must remain frozen for the operation's lifetime even if environment/config/CWD mutate, with explicit input overriding environment which overrides project config
Store/config helpers must consult the bound snapshot before falling back to ambient load_config, eliminating per-tool emit_shadow_snapshot calls across 34 + 24 _mcp_reads/_mcp_writes sites
Composition must fail OPEN on ConfigError (never raise), allowing operations that do not require config to continue; malformed selected config prevents zero lock/subprocess/network/store effects
Push mode (REBAR_SYNC_PUSH toggle in _io/import_ndjson.py mid-bulk-import) remains deliberately LIVE per-call as a documented carve-out, distinct from the frozen snapshot for other config

All CLI, MCP/Python command, and store-opening entry points must be proven by metamorphic tests to compose-once and reuse the snapshot reentrantly, with mutation-based tests confirming freezing behavior and E2E tests confirming no schema/event format changes
